SA.instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree M/51, 2005, with 2017 amendments)

passport_custody.citation: KSA Labor Law Art. 6 + MoHRSD Decision 166/2017
passport_custody.rule: Employers may NOT retain workers' passports under any circumstances. Workers must keep their own identity documents.
passport_custody.enforcement: moderate — explicit prohibition but reports of non-compliance persist

working_hours.rule: Standard working hours: 8 hours/day or 48 hours/week. During Ramadan: 6 hours/day or 36 hours/week for Muslim workers.
working_hours.note: Domestic workers historically excluded; partial coverage since 2013.

wage_deductions.rule: Deductions from wages limited to specific authorized purposes. No open-ended employer-discretion deductions permitted.

rest_days.rule: At least one weekly rest day (Friday by default).
rest_days.note: Domestic workers under separate regulation 310/1434H — weaker enforcement.

recruitment_fees.citation: No explicit ban; subject to MoHRSD circulars
recruitment_fees.rule: Worker-paid recruitment fees not explicitly prohibited under KSA law.
recruitment_fees.note: KSA has not ratified ILO C181 (Private Employment Agencies).

termination_notice.rule: Notice period required unless gross breach. Domestic-worker provisions weaker.

passport_custody.citation: Anti-Trafficking in Persons and Anti-Smuggling of Migrants Act 2007 + MoHR Directive
passport_custody.rule: Employer retention of worker passports constitutes a trafficking offence indicator.

working_hours.rule: Maximum 45 hours per week. Maximum 8 hours per day.

wage_deductions.rule: Deductions restricted to specific lawful categories (overpayment, advances, court orders). Total deduction capped at 50% of wages.

rest_days.rule: At least one rest day per week.

recruitment_fees.citation: Workers' Minimum Standards of Housing and Amenities Act + Employment (Recruitment Fees) Regulation
recruitment_fees.rule: Recruitment fees borne by employer for foreign workers under Zero Cost Recruitment policy.

SG.instrument: Employment of Foreign Manpower Act + Employment Act

passport_custody.rule: Employers must not retain workers' passports.

working_hours.rule: Maximum 44 hours per week for covered employees.

passport_custody.rule: Employer must return passport; retention without justification unlawful.
Employer may not retain worker passport. Violations punishable.
